analysis: The PR changes one line in docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head line 1274), a doc bullet about doctor output: App Attest serving authorization can stay visible through its unexpired lease, while MDM removal advice requires a matching fresh coordinator decision. That line falls outside the two supplied text units (head lines 1-385 and 386-794). I examined it only through the patch excerpt, and I reviewed the surrounding text of both units. The change is documentation-only, with no code, config, protocol or default change. Its wording is consistent with the threat model's TB-011, T-053 and T-057 posture: the lease is bounded and expiring, and the MDM removal advice is gated on fresh coordinator state. It does not claim new authorization, relax any control or change cache, TTL or revocation semantics (T-041 is untouched). The rest of the supplied file text is pre-existing and was not flagged. One limit: the referenced ../reference/provider-authorization.md and the doctor implementation were not supplied, so I could not check that the doc matches the code. That is a documentation-accuracy question, not a demonstrated regression. No security regression or new attack surface was identified.
